prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election (this panellist's call). The Costa Mesa panellist who had already, against the field, picked Trump to take the Republican nomination when 17 Republicans still contested it follows the same chart judgment through to the general election: Trump defeats Hillary Clinton on 8 November 2016, despite most polls favouring Clinton. Time coordinate: election day, 8 November 2016. Confidence: moderate-low (a single astrologer's contrarian call, but one with a demonstrated prior hit on the same candidate in the same cycle).
basis:
Card carries no tradition/system field; the card singles out one panel astrologer and that astrologer's earlier correct nomination call, so the system is self-decided from the card's genre as Western astrology (individual election forecast), and the unit of prediction is this astrologer's call, not the panel consensus.
systems_used: Western astrology (individual election forecast)

Object check: winner = Trump; the nomination call and the general-election call are kept as two faces of one judgment, per the card's own framing. Initial-direction anchor (calibration §9): initial direction = Trump wins, basis = the astrologer's demonstrated Trump judgment line on the card; direction unchanged, R81-REV1 change gate not applicable. Magnitude (§8): winner only; no margin claimed (no pointer on the card). This case is deliberately read separately from the panel-consensus case: the card itself separates this astrologer from the panel setting.
